_meta.indication: For the treatment of adult and pediatric patients with solid tumors that have an NTRK gene fusion without a known acquired resistance mutation, are metastatic or where surgical resection is likely to result in severe morbidity, and have no satisfactory alternative treatments or that have progressed following treatment; approved under accelerated approval.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, open-label, single-arm dose-finding and safety-evaluating trial in adult patients with advanced solid tumors
pivotal_trials.population: Adult and pediatric patients with unresectable or metastatic NTRK fusion-positive solid tumors (efficacy pooled across the 3 trials)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall response rate (ORR) and duration of response; approval based on ORR and DOR
pivotal_trials.n: Pooled efficacy population of 55 patients (safety database 176 patients)
pivotal_trials.result: Pooled ORR 75% (95% CI: 61%, 85%), CR 22%, PR 53%; median DOR not reached, response duration 1.6 to 33.2 months

pivotal_trials.design: Ongoing open-label, multicenter basket trial in patients 12 years of age and older with advanced cancer harboring an NTRK1, NTRK2, or NTRK3 fusion
pivotal_trials.population: Patients 12 years of age and older with advanced NTRK fusion-positive cancer
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall response rate and duration of response (pooled analysis basis)
pivotal_trials.n: Contributed to pooled efficacy population of 55 patients
pivotal_trials.result: Pooled ORR 75% (95% CI: 61%, 85%) across the three trials

pivotal_trials.design: Ongoing multicenter open-label study of larotrectinib in pediatric patients with an advanced solid tumor or a primary CNS tumor
pivotal_trials.population: Pediatric patients with advanced solid tumor or primary CNS tumor
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall response rate and duration of response (pooled analysis basis)
pivotal_trials.n: Contributed to pooled efficacy population of 55 patients
pivotal_trials.result: Pooled ORR 75% (95% CI: 61%, 85%) across the three trials

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%): fatigue, nausea, dizziness, vomiting, anemia, increased AST, cough, increased ALT, constipation, diarrhea. Primary serious risks are hepatotoxicity and neurotoxicity: increased transaminases of any grade in 45% (Grade 3 AST/ALT in 6%); neurologic adverse reactions of any grade in 53% (Grade 3 in 6%, Grade 4 in 0.6%).
target_moa: Kinase inhibitor with reversible activity against tropomyosin receptor kinases TRKA, TRKB, and TRKC (encoded by NTRK1, NTRK2, NTRK3); targets oncogenic NTRK gene fusion proteins.

advisory_committee.vote: FDA did not hold an advisory committee meeting because no review issues were identified that raised significant public health questions regarding the risk:benefit assessment.

description.text: Updated prescribing information with revised response data and expanded safety population for NTRK fusion solid tumors (no new indication)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for revisions to the prescribing information (PI) updating the response data from patients with NTRK fusion solid tumors. Additionally, labeling changes were made to Adverse Reactions (Section 6.1) and Pediatric Use (Section 8.4) based on updated safety data expanding the safety population. Warnings and Precautions Section 5.1 was updated to "Central Nervous System Effects" with language to clarify cognitive impairment and other disorders and to Section 5.2 to update "Skeletal Fractures" language. Finally, edits to associated with the previously described edits were made to the Patient Information and Instructions for Use.

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to regular approval for adult and pediatric patients with NTRK gene fusion solid tumors

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on overall response rate and duration of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials.

confirmatory_requirement.text: As a condition of accelerated approval, the sponsor must provide additional data under postmarketing requirement 3540-1 to verify and describe clinical benefit through more precise ORR estimation and mature response duration.

citations.quote: As a condition of the accelerated approval, Loxo Oncology must provide additional data under a postmarketing requirement to verify and further describe the clinical benefit of larotrectinib.

3540-1 Submit the final report, including datasets, from ongoing and proposed trials conducted to verify and describe the clinical benefit of larotrectinib, through more precise estimation of the overall response rate and mature response duration per independent review assessment

basis.text: Granted July 11, 2016 for unresectable or metastatic solid tumors with NTRK-fusion proteins in adult and pediatric patients requiring systemic therapy who progressed following prior treatment or have no acceptable alternative treatments.

requirement.text: 3540-1: Submit final report/datasets from ongoing and proposed trials to verify and describe clinical benefit through more precise ORR estimation and mature response duration in patients with NTRK fusion solid tumors, characterizing response for colorectal cancer, NSCLC, CNS tumors, and melanoma, with a minimum of 40 patients with other cancer types.

citations.quote: 3540-1 Submit the final report, including datasets, from ongoing and proposed trials conducted to verify and describe the clinical benefit of larotrectinib, through more precise estimation of the overall response rate and mature response duration per independent review assessment

A minimum of 40 patients with cancers other than colorectal cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, central nervous system tumors, melanoma, soft tissue sarcoma, thyroid cancer, infantile fibrosarcoma, and salivary cancers

requirement.text: 3540-2: Submit final report/datasets from the first 55 patients with NTRK-fusion solid tumors across LOXO-TRK-14001, SCOUT, and NAVIGATE to further characterize duration of response; responders followed at least 2 years from onset of response.

citations.quote: 3540-2 Submit the final report, including datasets, from the first 55 patients with NTRK-fusion solid tumors enrolled across Study LOXO-TRK-14001 (NCT02122913), SCOUT (NCT02637687), and NAVIGATE (NCT02576431), to further characterize the duration of response

requirement.text: 3540-3: Conduct a study in a sufficient number of pediatric patients with NTRK-fusion solid tumors to evaluate the potential serious risk of adverse long-term effects of larotrectinib on growth and development, with neurologic and developmental assessments.

citations.quote: 3540-3 Conduct a study of larotrectinib in a sufficient number of pediatric patients with NTRK-fusion solid tumors to evaluate the potential serious risk of adverse long-term effects of larotrectinib on the growth and development of pediatric patients.

requirement.text: 3540-4: Conduct a study of larotrectinib 100 mg orally once daily in patients (BSA ≥1.0 m2) who required a third dosage modification to better characterize the tolerability of this approved dosage modification.

citations.quote: 3540-4 Conduct a study of larotrectinib 100 mg orally once daily in a sufficient number of adult or pediatric patients with a body surface area of at least 1.0 m2 who experienced an adverse reaction requiring a third dosage modification of larotrectinib to better characterize the tolerability of this approved dosage modification for larotrectinib.

requirement.text: 3540-5: Conduct a physiologically-based pharmacokinetic modeling study to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor on single-dose pharmacokinetics of larotrectinib to address potential for excessive drug toxicity.

citations.quote: 3540-5 Conduct a physiologically-based pharmacokinetic modeling study to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor on the single dose

requirement.text: 3540-6: Conduct a physiologically-based pharmacokinetic modeling study to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inducer on single-dose pharmacokinetics of larotrectinib to assess decreased drug exposure and appropriate dosing.

citations.quote: 3540-6 Conduct a physiologically-based pharmacokinetic modeling study to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inducer on the single dose

requirement.text: 3540-7: Conduct an analytical and clinical validation study, using clinical trial data, adequate to support labeling of an in vitro diagnostic device essential to the safe and effective use of larotrectinib for patients with NTRK gene fusions in solid tumor specimens.
